messages:
Mia R.: opened a PR that changes KMS/HSM rotation flow and adds audit fields — need eng-security + infra eyes before we can merge for compliance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/427

Summary:
- rotate keys via `hsm-manager` service instead of ad-hoc script
- `audit.events` table: added `source_service` and `kms_key_id` columns
- migration: small backfill script included
- requires an approver from eng-security and infra

Runbook snippet:
```
# backfill audit kms_key_id
python tools/backfill_audit.py --from-date=2025-01-01
```

CI: intermittent failure on `test_hsm_key_sync` — investigating. Can someone take a quick look? @Jason L. @Sophia K. :eyes:

Jason L.: taking a look now, will focus on migration + perms.

security-bot: SAST/Config scan completed — flagged 1 config issue: missing HSM policy binding in `hsm-manager` config. See https://ci.redwood-infra/reports/scan/427 (auto report).

Mia R.: pushed a fix for the policy binding and updated the PR description with the change. Also added a short migration checklist. Rerunning CI.

deploy-bot: CI: build #2345 triggered for commit `9f3a2b` — integration job failed previously, rerun in progress.

Sophia K.: quick pass — schema change looks sensible. Main ask: add retention rationale + compliance note in the PR (why `kms_key_id` is kept, retention window). Left a couple inline nits.

Leo P.: left a non-blocking comment re linter in `hsm_client.py` (pep8/variable name), nothing functional.

Mia R.: addressed Sophia's retention rationale and tagged the PR `compliance:needs-review`. Fixed the linter warning and pushed. Re-running tests.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed on `9f3a2b` — integration job green.

Jason L.: approve — two minor doc comments about retry/backoff but not blocking. :white_check_mark:

Mia R.: thanks all. will wait 30m for canary window per merge policy then merge and roll out to staging. Posting the rollback steps in the runbook. :lock_with_ink_pen:
